mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Area High School, and we are currently seeing a third quarter moon.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to highlight how city planners help us navigate growth and land use, while the Verona Senior Center is currently looking for volunteers for their tri-shaw bike program that offers scenic rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.

We have plenty to look forward to including Live Music at Bailey's Run happening today, the Dane County Farmer's Market taking place tomorrow, and the Farley Center Fall Festival coming up on October 4th.
On September 14, a local man was arrested during a traffic stop for violating his probation and operating after revocation.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and you can stop by when the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
